entries.name: AFTERPAY_MERCHANT_ID
entries.description: The merchant's Afterpay Merchant ID, sent with the Secret Key as HTTP Basic auth to list payments. Not a secret, but it names the merchant's account.
howToGet: Afterpay gives the Merchant ID and Secret Key together when the merchant account is set up. A merchant administrator can ask their Afterpay account manager for them, or find them where Afterpay sent them.

entries.name: AFTERPAY_SECRET_KEY
entries.description: The merchant's Afterpay Secret Key. Afterpay can't limit it to reading, so it could also capture, refund and void orders; the connector only ever sends GET requests to List Payments.
howToGet: Copy the Secret Key that came with the Merchant ID straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Sandbox and production each have their own pair; set AFTERPAY_ENVIRONMENT to match.

entries.name: AFTERPAY_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Which Afterpay host the credentials are for: sandbox (global-api-sandbox.afterpay.com) or production (global-api.afterpay.com). There is no default, so a sandbox setting can't reach a live account by accident and the other way round.
howToGet: Use sandbox with sandbox credentials from the Afterpay account manager, and production with the live pair.
